import json
from pathlib import Path
from blue_line import read_with_surfaces,build_envelope,build_report,replay_report
from blue_line.json_adapter import declaration_from_json
context=json.loads(Path("data/example_contexts.json").read_text())["blue_line_worked.json"]
declaration=declaration_from_json(json.loads(Path("data/declared_files/blue_line_worked.json").read_text()))
reading,surfaces=read_with_surfaces(declaration,as_of=context["review_date"])
envelope=build_envelope(reading,subject_id=context["subject_id"],source_snapshot_refs=tuple(context["source_snapshot_refs"]))
replayed,_=replay_report(build_report(reading,surfaces))
assert envelope==build_envelope(replayed,subject_id=context["subject_id"],source_snapshot_refs=tuple(context["source_snapshot_refs"]))
print(json.dumps(envelope,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
